question: My sister is ___ tall ___ me.
explanation: So sánh bằng: as + adj + as.

question: This box is ___ than that one.
explanation: Tính từ ngắn 1 âm tiết: big → bigger + than.

question: She is ___ than she was last year.
explanation: Tính từ tận cùng -y: happy → happier.

question: This exercise is ___ than the last one.
explanation: Tính từ dài (2+ âm tiết): more + adj + than.

question: Today I feel ___ than yesterday.
explanation: Good → better (bất quy tắc).

question: He is the ___ student in our class.
explanation: So sánh nhất từ ngắn: the + tallest.

question: It was the ___ film I have ever seen.
explanation: Good → best (so sánh nhất).

question: Your coffee is not ___ good ___ mine.
explanation: So sánh bằng phủ định: not as/so + adj + as.

question: She runs ___ than her brother.
explanation: Trạng từ fast giống tính từ ngắn: fast → faster.

question: This is the ___ building in the city.
explanation: High → higher / highest (từ ngắn).

question: The weather is getting ___ and ___.
explanation: So sánh lũy tiến: adj-er and adj-er.

question: I don't have ___ money ___ you.
explanation: Money không đếm được → as much money as.

question: There are ___ students in Class A than in Class B.
explanation: Students đếm được số nhiều → fewer (không dùng less).

question: She is the best player ___ the team.
explanation: Superlative + in + nhóm/tổ chức (the team).

question: This is ___ expensive than I expected.
explanation: Much/far/a lot + comparative: much more expensive.

question: His idea is ___ than mine.
explanation: Bad → worse (bất quy tắc).

question: My ___ brother lives in Hanoi. (thứ bậc trong gia đình)
explanation: Elder/eldest dùng cho thành viên gia đình (thứ bậc).

question: We need ___ instructions before we start. (thông tin thêm)
explanation: Further = thêm nữa (thông tin), không chỉ khoảng cách vật lý.

question: She is ___ than she looks.
explanation: Clever có thể cleverer hoặc more clever; more clever phổ biến trong văn viết.

question: It was the ___ day of the summer.
explanation: Superlative + of + mốc thời gian/nhóm.

question: ___ we wait, ___ expensive it becomes.
explanation: Cấu trúc song song: The + comparative…, the + comparative…

question: He was more mad ___ brave.
explanation: So sánh hai phẩm chất cùng một người: more + adj + than.

question: She is one of the ___ people I know.
explanation: One of the + superlative + danh từ số nhiều.

question: Which sentence is CORRECT?
options: This is more taller than that.
This is more tall than that.
explanation: Không dùng double comparative (more + -er).

question: Homer was greater than all the ___ Greek poets.
explanation: So sánh trong nhóm cần other để không so với chính mình.

question: We want ___ cheap a flight as possible.
explanation: Văn trang trọng: as + adj + a/an + noun + as.

question: In formal writing: She earns more than ___.
explanation: Văn trang trọng: than + chủ ngữ + trợ động từ (than I do).

question: This is ___ the best solution we have.
explanation: By far + superlative = nhấn mạnh mức độ cao nhất.

question: After years of saving, they are much ___ now.
explanation: Tính từ ghép well-off → better-off (so sánh hơn).

script: The more you practice, the more confident you become.
question: The more you ___ (practice), the more confident you become.
explanation: The more + clause (Present Simple), the more + adj: luyện càng nhiều càng tự tin.
